boneyard.note: Shuffled pool of undrawn tiles. Server deals 7 to each player at start.

hand.note: Each player's private hand of domino tiles.

chain.note: The line of played tiles. First and last tiles determine open ends.

tile.note: Double-six domino tile. Each tile has two halves with 0-6 pips. All 28 unique combinations from [0,0] to [6,6].

phases.name: deal
phases.note: Server shuffles boneyard and deals 7 tiles to each player's hand.

phases.name: play
phases.note: Players alternate playing a tile matching an open end, or passing if no playable tile.

library.no_playable_tile: hand.all(tile, tile.half_a != open_end_left && tile.half_a != open_end_right && tile.half_b != open_end_left && tile.half_b != open_end_right)

play_tile.definition: Place a tile from hand onto one end of the chain. One half of the tile must match the open end being played to.
constraints: tile is in current player hand

pass.definition: Pass the turn. Only legal when no tile in hand can match either open end of the chain.

first_play.definition: First tile may be played freely with no matching constraint.
